title: finding(app-shell): the failed-roster notice is written twice: `InspectorSelectField` renders it inline in `inspectors/_shared.tsx`, not exported, and `HookDefaultInspector` (objectui#10585) repeats its markup by hand
body:
Filing-gate category: ② one fact, two hand-kept renderings (drift risk, no defect today), with named sites. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10585 dev report and PR objectui#10644 (merged as `785d3a73`). The dev copied the markup because `_shared.tsx` was read-only for that card, and said so in a source comment and the PR body. The seat listed the export as owed. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` `f905090a1`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/_shared.tsx:557-579`: `InspectorSelectField`'s failure arm (objectui#9651). It renders a `p` with `role="status"`, `data-testid="inspector-select-roster-failure"`, the amber `text-[11px] leading-snug` tone, then `rosterFailureLabel`, then an explicit `{' '}` and the cause in a `font-mono text-[10px] opacity-80` span. The label defaults to `DEFAULT_ROSTER_FAILURE_LABEL_KEY = 'engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle'` (`:326`). It is inline JSX in the primitive, with no exported component.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx:252-271`: the same notice, copied for the hook's object checkbox list. It has the same element, role, classes, key (`tr('engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle')`), spacer and cause span, with `data-testid="hook-object-roster-failure"`. Its comment at `:252-257` says: "That notice lives inside the primitive and is not exported, and this picker is a checkbox list rather than a select, so the markup is repeated here".
- A third rendering of the same fact at the picker layer, `PickerLoadFailure` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx:409`, objectui#5170), is a `div[role="status"]` with its own shape. The `_shared.tsx:510-518` comment names it as the model the inspector notice follows.

Today the two inspector copies match, so nothing renders wrong. The risk is the objectui#9651 / objectui#10585 shape: a later change to the notice (role, tone, the spacer that keeps the accessible name from running on, the key) lands in one copy and not the other.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Export one small notice component from `_shared.tsx`, for example `RosterFailureNotice({ message, label?, testId })`, which renders exactly the markup above. Have `InspectorSelectField`'s failure arm and `HookDefaultInspector` both render it, keeping each call site's existing `data-testid` so the pins in `HookDefaultInspector.rosterFailure.test.tsx` and the `inspector-select-roster-failure` pins in `_shared.rosterFailure.test.tsx` and `ViewColumnInspector.rosterFailure.test.tsx` hold unchanged. Whether `PickerLoadFailure` should share it is a separate question (different element, different host), and is out of scope unless triage says otherwise.

## Dedupe

REST read of objectui issues and PRs (the 1000 most recent, plus every item updated since 2026-09-25T12:00Z; 1069 items), titles and bodies matched against `roster-failure|rosterFailure` and `optionsLoadFailedTitle`. Hits: objectui#10585 / PR objectui#10644 (the source of the copy), PR objectui#10445 and PR objectui#10678 (locale work on the same keys; neither extracts the notice), and this seat's own seat post. No card proposes the export. Lit control: the same walk finds PR objectui#10644 for `rosterFailure`.
